document.about: Hobart AM15 dishwasher specification sheet (8 pages), a dealer's stamped copy. Its fonts map the hyphen a line break sets, drawn with ink, to U+00AD SOFT HYPHEN. Hobart's own copy of the sheet maps the same hyphens to `-`.

notes: The soft hyphen stayed in the text and a space followed it, so every word broken at a line's end read in two: `microcom­ puter`.

checks.issue: microcom­ / puter read as two words, the soft hyphen kept between them.
As above, for a word broken after a compound's own hyphen: self-flush­ / ing.
As above, with two letters carried to the next line: accidental­ / ly.
Soft hyphens were kept in the text, where a reader shows nothing for them.
